title: Japanese Chilli Crusted Salmon
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring a spicy chilli crust on pan-seared salmon. Best served with steamed vegetables.

ingredients.name: bake flour
ingredients.notes: Panko or regular flour for coating

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Season the salmon fillets with salt and set aside.
In a bowl, mix together the chillies, herbal oil, and a pinch of salt.
Coat the salmon fillets evenly with the chilli mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Dip the chilli-coated salmon in the bake flour, shaking off excess.
Place the coated salmon on the prepared baking tray and bake for 12-15 minutes.
While the salmon is baking, heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Remove the salmon from the oven and carefully place it in the pan, skin-side up.
Pan-fry the salmon for 2-3 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
